measurement: close before print to close after first full session

names.reversal_note: Compound case was 'Q3 gross margin clears Q2's 15.6% AND FY guide stays intact.' Half fired: reported home-sales gross margin was 15.8% (above 15.6%). Half did not: FY26 delivery guidance was cut to 80,000-81,000 from the prior 82,000-83,000. The stated case did not play out as written, but the direction it pointed toward (up) still won -- for a different reason (an already-shredded bar plus a hawkish-but-fully-priced Fed, not the margin/guide combination named).
names.notes: GAAP EPS $1.19 vs ~$1.29-1.30 consensus (below guide's $1.20-1.40 low end); revenue $8.05B vs ~$8.31-8.32B consensus (miss); FY26 delivery guide cut 82-83k -> 80-81k. Every headline number the panel and the preliminary read leaned on for the bear case printed negative or in line with the bear case, and the stock still closed up 1.71%. FOMC (90 minutes before the release) delivered a 25bp hike, 12-0, with 16 of 18 officials projecting another hike this year -- the hawkish outcome the panel's bear case assumed, not the dovish surprise three personas flagged as the swing risk. The move looks like relief off an already-washed-out setup (4-year low, 8.5% short interest, targets at/below spot, no upgrades) rather than either named scenario.
